featured_reviews.name: Yash Karaday
featured_reviews.review_text: Alfa Ice Cream never disappoints! Their Bavarian Chocolate flavor is my absolute favorite—rich, creamy, and so satisfying. The best part? It’s all at a budget-friendly price. The new interiors are a great touch, adding a fresh and inviting vibe. The only downside is that they need to work on their delivery service during rush hours. featured_reviews.review_text: Best quality Kulfi and Ice cream are available but opposite to E ward. We tried kesar Pista every bit I am getting dry fruits.

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: If you love falooda and are looking for an amazing one, Alfa Icecream should definitely be your first pick. There’s something charming about this generationally run family business that’s been around since years. Maybe it’s their icecreams all made inhouse, the uniqueness of their desserts, that vintage feel that icecream from the 90’s used to have or just the richness and taste in everything they serve - this place is a must visit for all dessert lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Sonigra Saurab
featured_reviews.review_text: I tried to order something that was still undiscovered in my area and in that search I landed on this shop. Being an unknown shop I didn't have a high expectations and I didn't want to order anything extravagant so I order a basic Oreo ice cream but to my surprise the taste was really good . Packing and everything was great. Appreciate the taste. Just a small suggestion would be creating same ice cream with choclate instead of vanilla base.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Mango Jars ice cream 🍨🥭 The quantity felt a bit less, but the quality was excellent. The delightful layers of signature mango mousse made with real Alphonso mangoes give a rich, fruity taste. A perfect treat for mango lovers!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited TIB in Byculla, and it was an absolute treat! The variety of flavors was impressive, like chocolate and Guava. The taste and quality of the ice cream was incredible ….you could tell they use high-quality ingredients.

The staff was friendly and offered great recommendations, the way Dubey family attend their customers made the experience even better and welcoming.

Whether you're looking for a quick scoop or something more indulgent like a sundae, TIB is definitely a must-visit for ice cream lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Ninad Gaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text: This is good joint serving fresh ice cream unlike other ice cream serving frozen and not using any preservative so safe for kids specially which also come with good taste so it is healthy and not getting compromised with taste. I’m chocolate maniac and tried Dark night which one of best chocolate icecream have eaten. They have fruits options also their which are way better than Natural ice creams which are unlike frozen but fresh.Visited most of outlets and service and ambience is very good and gives good vibe

featured_reviews.name: pravin sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: Last time when I visited here, I tried 3 ice-cream flavours at a time. As it was to authentic, natural, no added chemical flavours, pure veg and nicely presented. I took Dark night, Musk-Watermelon and Newyorkers ( ice-cream with CheeseCake added), all of these 3 were best in taste. And best part is you get the ice-cream made in front of you, so you can see magic happening with your eyes.

featured_reviews.name: T Arokia Rianna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had Naturals Ice Cream before, but this was my first time visiting their parlour — and I loved it! The place is small but has a really cool interior and is super clean and hygienic.

Now coming to the ice cream — oh my goodness! The coconut flavour is hands down my favourite and an absolute must-try. True to its name, the ice creams here are made with natural ingredients, and every flavour tastes rich and authentic. They also offer a variety of fruity options to choose from.

If you haven’t visited this place yet, you’re definitely missing out. Go treat yourself!

featured_reviews.name: Veikho Asanii
featured_reviews.review_text: Nothing taste like NATURALS when it comes to ice cream. Kalina outlet is a great place to drop in. Double scoop or single, cup or cone. If you have big appetite, go for double scoop with different flavour. Located by the highway, ample of space in and out. Good surrounding, a great place to have your ice cream and take a walk if your wish to. Tender coconut my favorite,  now it's kaju kismis. Delicious 😋.

featured_reviews.review_text: Staff was too good, happily offered all type of flavour to taste....we enjoyed sitafal, coconut and walnut ice cream.

featured_reviews.name: Senorita Kinny
featured_reviews.review_text: Naturals, like always has amazing ice-creams with real fresh fruits and flavors. This particular outlet also has gajar halwa on the menu. Seasonal fruits such as mangoes and strawberrys are served with real fruit cut pieces with malai ice cream on request (chargeable). My personal favorite best flavored ice-creams are strawberry (seasonal), tender coconut, mango (seasonal),  chikoo. Do try them!

featured_reviews.name: Paarth Powar
featured_reviews.review_text: Natural Ice Cream offers a delightful variety of flavors with a focus on using natural ingredients. The rich and creamy texture enhances the overall experience, making it a refreshing choice for ice cream enthusiasts. Standout flavors like  Mango and Tender Coconut provide a unique and satisfying taste. Overall, a recommended treat for those seeking high-quality, natural flavors in their ice cream.

featured_reviews.name: dayne castelino
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Ice cream is delicious as ever, but no innovation or new flavours being added. Same old flavours which are the best but would love if Naturals come out with more newer innovation on flavours.
Location is perfect as it is closest to the Kalina market and in view for all to come over.
Best strategy of making fresh waffle cones in the open right outside the outlet, the aroma pulls the person in.
Staff wise it's proper 4 people attending their jobs perfectly.
Life saver is the acceptance on debit/credit cards.
It's outlet could easily hold 10 people at a time which is proper.
Don't understand why are off season flavours still on the board, when it not their season.
Would have given a 2 star but I myself am a Naturals ice cream lover.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Poojari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai’s legendary premium Apsara Ice Creams has been serving real fruit ice creams since 1971, and honestly the taste still feels unmatched! 🍦🥭

Tried their famous Chilli Guava flavour and it was absolutely amazing — the perfect mix of sweet, spicy, and refreshing. Their mango ice creams were also super rich, natural, and full of real fruit flavour.

Loved the quality, freshness, and unique flavours. Also excited about their new Mango Khojo Hunt Contest — such a fun and creative idea that no other ice cream brand has done before!

One of the best ice cream places in Mumbai for sure. Highly recommended! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Bouffage renz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai’s legendary premium Apsara Ice Creams — serving real fruit ice creams since 1971 — truly delivers. The flavors feel so natural and creamy, especially the mango, Guava Masala, Kesar Pista, and Ferrero Rocher. It actually tastes like real fruit!
Overall, excellent experience. Highly recommended, especially with the ongoing Mango Khojo Hunt Contest! 🍦

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience ordering ice creams from Gokul. The ice creams were super  Delicious and creamy . I really like their icecream and even Shrikhand. Its not very sweet, and fruit flavours are also refreshing.
What we ordered :
Flavours :
* Mango ice cream ( my favourite)
* Roasted Almond (must try )

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Omar
featured_reviews.review_text: Great ice-cream parlor in Santa Cruz. Tons of ice-cream flavors to choose from. My relatives favor this shop all the time for their ice-cream cravings. Pretty solid flavors to say. Definitely try it out.

featured_reviews.name: prabha goswami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have you tried out Gokul icecreams yet?? No then you should try it out, I am sure you gonna love their icecreams. one of the oldest icecream brands which has been serving deliciousness since ages now 💥✨🌟 I tried out their:-
🤤 Tender coconut

featured_reviews.review_text: I have developed a deep affection for Gokul Ice Cream for their wide-ranging selection of delectable flavors. I recently had the pleasure of savoring their Cheese Almond, Mango, Dragon Fruit, and Dry Fruit varieties, and I must say, their flavors are nothing short of exquisite. What better way to celebrate Ganesh Utsav than with the delightful offerings of Gokul Ice Cream, a true favorite among our family!

featured_reviews.name: Drashti Maniyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gokul Icecream really serves the freshest and purest ice cream. Also the flavours are really good. Choco cream was amazing and my favourite with peach apricot. I've also tried dragon fruit and butterscotch. All the flavours are really blissful. You won't be able to stop at one scoop, I promise.
Another highly recommended flavour - malai.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Supal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently ordered icecream from @gokulicecreams located in
Santacruz having rich heritage since 1970
Icecream quality, taste and flavours is not compressed here. Definitely a perfect option for family celebrations.
Have a cup or family pack at @gokulicecreams. They also have Shrikhand at their store and even it's creamy and loaded one. Tried Kesar Shrikhand which had good generous amount of dry fruits and kesar with right sweetness and creaminess
Order from Zomato or Dine in at their outlet in Santacruz.

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Duvedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing ice cream/milkshakes, they have a wide selection of natural flavours
Which range from seasonal to perennial most of which are delicious but I guess that's up to personal preferences.

My absolute favourite here is the sitaphal ice cream.

The ice cream consistency and mixture is amazingly smooth and no fragmented flakes will hit your tongue and extreme value for money for just 70/- rupees for the scoop with a waffle cone.

My only problem is that this shop doesn't have more outlets, I travelled from Chembur just to have this ice cream, and for the night drive of course.

featured_reviews.name: VlogWithFurkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tender Fresh located in Kalina, and it was such a sweet experience! 🍦✨
They are currently running a Valentine’s special offer from 12th Feb to 18th Feb where you can buy 2 scoops and get 1 scoop absolutely FREE – which honestly makes it a perfect dessert date spot.
Talking about the taste, we tried their Mango Ice Cream which was super creamy and refreshing. The Chilli Guava Ice Cream was totally hatke – sweet with a spicy twist that actually works so well! Their Chocolate Ice Cream was rich and classic, perfect for chocolate lovers.
The Kala Jamun Shake was something unique and indulgent – proper desi flavour in shake form. And to end on a sweet note, we had their Baklava dessert which was perfectly sweet and satisfying.
They have a good variety of ice creams, shakes and special desserts, so there’s something for everyone. Overall, great taste, good quantity and value for money. Definitely recommended for couples, friends and even solo dessert dates!
Will surely visit again. 🍨❤️

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri
featured_reviews.review_text: If like me you crave something cool during winters then Tender fresh icecrean has to be your go to spot. From tasty scoops shakes to sundae desserts this place has it all. We tried the timeless scoops chilli guava and tender coconut and the seasonsl delight blueberry which were the most tasty ever. The baklava with a scoop of malai icecream caught our attention which was a tasteful delight. Simply mesmerised by their falooda icecream which had a geberous scoops of dry fruit icrcream, kesar pista and falooda the service was quick and friendly staff. Loved their presentations and serve size. Ended our cravings with a chikoo shake taste and quality guaranteed

featured_reviews.name: MINA DA DHABA
featured_reviews.review_text: this is the best place to try nutty baklava and icecreams in kalina. they have amazing taste and variety of flavours available. I tried their Christmas and New year special flavour strawberry chocolate which was very delicious. also mango and roasted almonds were very tasty. I tried their tender coconut milkshake which was too yummy. tasted very creamy, rich and refreshing. In dessert would recommend you to try their nutty baklava with malai icecream. it was heavenly. cosy seating and friendly staff. good place to hangout and have delicious icecream

featured_reviews.name: rumana patel
featured_reviews.review_text:

Also had the Lotus Biscoff thick shake and brownie with malai ice cream...absolutely delicious!
Great quality and flavours. Highly recommend 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Dreams unlimited By Divya joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had such a lovely experience at Tender Fresh ❤️
Tried their Chickoo ice cream, Choco Chips, Sundae, Dry Fruit Shake and Hazelnut — and honestly everything tasted super fresh, rich and delicious! 😍 The flavors were really good and the quality felt premium, especially the creamy texture and perfect sweetness.
The staff and service were equally amazing. Everyone was polite, friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. 😊 The outlet was clean, nicely maintained and had a very positive vibe.
A great place to chill, enjoy desserts and spend quality time with family or friends. Definitely visiting again soon! 🍨💖

featured_reviews.name: bindi yajnik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tender Fresh is a total dessert delight!
Creamy texture, rich flavours, and a premium feel in every scoop. The Biscoff ice cream is a must-try, and their chocolate-based flavours are super indulgent.
Perfect spot to satisfy sweet cravings. Definitely adding this to my repeat list
The sundae ice cream was rich and indulgent, and the chocolate milkshake was thick, creamy, and perfectly chocolaty. Fresh flavours, great quality, and totally worth it. A must-visit for dessert lovers

featured_reviews.name: Faisal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Surely an Hidden Gem Alert for All Dessert Lovers! 🍨✨

Visited Tender Fresh Ice Cream on Santacruz Kalina Road and was blown away by their range of desserts. Tried the Nutty Baklava with Malai Ice Cream topped with honey and nuts — absolutely too good! The Sitafal Thick Shake and Chocolate Shake were both rich, creamy, and solid in taste.

Also indulged in their Dry Fruit Ice Cream in a Waffle Cone, along with Seasonal Blueberry and Chilli Guava flavors — each one stood out with awesome quality and freshness.

The place has a superb ambience and lovely vibes, making it a perfect spot to chill and satisfy your dessert cravings.

featured_reviews.name: Tabish Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Tender Fresh, Kalina. Tried their brownie with malai ice cream and the chocolate overloaded sundae — both were rich, indulgent and absolutely delicious. A must-visit spot for dessert lovers!”

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taj Ice Cream is one of the oldest ice cream spots in Mumbai and it makes for the perfect dessert stop after exploring the surrounding areas of Mohammed Ali Road.

We tried the Alphonso Mango, Litchi, and Pineapple ice creams, and all three were excellent and some of the best I have had.

The Alphonso Mango stood out with its rich and authentic flavour, while the Litchi and Pineapple were refreshing and well-balanced.

The texture of the ice cream is smooth and slightly denser than regular commercial brands, which adds to its appeal.

Given its legacy and consistency, it continues to remain a favourite for many. It is especially enjoyable after a heavy Mughlai meal in the area. They also sell family packs for takeaways.

A highly recommended stop for dessert lovers visiting this part of Mumbai.

review_photos.caption: Taj Ice cream at Bohri Mohalla

featured_reviews.name: rosh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried this hand-churned ice cream and it honestly stands out from the usual. The texture is rich and creamy without being too heavy, and you can really taste the freshness in every bite.

The guava flavor was a surprise hit—perfectly balanced between sweet and tangy, just like real fruit. The mixed fruit was equally refreshing, with a nice blend that didn’t feel artificial at all.

Simple, authentic, and done right. Definitely coming back for more.

featured_reviews.name: Kanchan Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Quaint little place, with all the construction going on in the area, a little tough to find now but it is an institution, so anyone will happily lead you to the place. Tiny place but what it has to offer makes you forget everything else. Personally for me Chickoo and sitaphal were mid blowing! The other flavors were also great! So much so that we actually had a kilo of it parceled for home. It is a must try and it will beat any mass produced ice cream without a doubt!

featured_reviews.name: wilford machado
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best ice creams in the city. If i had to compare it with a more popular brand, i would say this is like a premium version of Naturals ice cream with denser and richer flavours. After trying almost all their flavours, I feel muskmelon, apricot and mango are my top favourites. Guava is good too but the spice they use has too much salt in it which can ruin the experience. While the entire experience is quite nice, wish they let customers taste before buying like most other premium ice cream vendors. Expensive for a shop with no seating but still worth the visit even if you are not in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Kuldip Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taj Ice Cream, Bohri Mohalla ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A Mumbai institution since 1887, Taj Ice Cream is the real deal. Six generations of the Jalalji family have kept the tradition alive — no additives, no shortcuts, just handmade ice cream churned the old-fashioned way with real fruit and secret family recipes.
The Cassata is legendary, the fruit flavours taste genuinely fresh, and the humble old-school setting in the heart of Bohri Mohalla adds to the charm. Tourists and locals alike swear by it, and one scoop tells you why.
Don’t visit Mumbai without stopping here.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Badri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Experience the most unique hand churned ice cream taste in Mumbai. If your travelling to Mumbai, don't miss out on this amazing ice cream heritage from 1930s.
Every season has their own flavors. We tried the standard mango, strawberry and in season Guava with tajin.
Enjoyed every flavor every spoon.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Gawand
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience at Taj Icecreams in Bohri Mohalla, Mohammed Ali Road. The ice cream is incredibly rich, creamy, and full of authentic flavor — especially the seasonal fruit options. Simple, old-school vibe with quick and friendly service. A must-visit if you’re in the area. Highly recommended! 🍨

featured_reviews.name: muku
featured_reviews.review_text: I'd heard about Taj Ice Cream online as an old (nearly 200 years old) establishment that was a favourite among golden era bollywood celebrities and used quality ingredients to make hand churned ice cream. We tried their malai, strawberry and guava flavours. All were understated and not too sweet with a chewy, dense texture, the best commercially available ice cream I've ever had. It seems to not be packed with much air and is so dense that you could fill yourself up on a scoop or two (costing 100 rs epr scoop). Loved the little photo of Waheeda Rehman enjoying her ice cream on the wall near the entrance.

featured_reviews.review_text:
They have some really good milkshakes and Ice-creams! Have heard about them a lot & they surely do have way too many outlets. I wanted to give it a try since a long time now. What I ordered was :

• Belgian Chocolate Milkshake (5/5): I absolutely love the bitterness Belgian chocolate has. This one was so delicious, I gulped it down within seconds! A must try.

featured_reviews.name: aatif pathan
featured_reviews.review_text: This ice cream tastes like it was made during a clearance sale. The texture is sad, the flavor is flat, and it’s packed with the cheapest, waxiest chocolate chips imaginable—like someone swept the floor of a discount candy factory and tossed the scraps in. Instead of melting nicely, it just… gives up. Calling this ice cream is generous; it’s more like frozen disappointment with budget chocolate gravel. Would not recommend unless you enjoy regret in a bowl.

I am a shake lover and I have tried out from many places, I and my friend decided to have a try to these outlet Frozen Bottle. I have heard about this place and finally tried today.

So the place is located near Mazgaon circle opposite Saifee Park, the ambiance of the place is cool and happening.

featured_reviews.name: Prince
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Frozen Bottle, and it was an amazing experience! ✨ The ambiance was warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxing treat. I tried their boba ice cream 🧋, chocolate hazelnut brownie milkshake 🍫🍪, and the mango and peach mocktail 🍷 – each one was a delightful surprise!

The boba ice cream had a perfect blend of texture and flavor, while the milkshake was rich, creamy, and decadently chocolaty with the hazelnut brownie adding a perfect crunch. 😋 The mango and peach mocktail with boba was refreshingly fruity and a great way to cleanse the palate. 🍹

The staff was courteous, and the service was prompt. 💜 Frozen Bottle is definitely a go-to spot for beverage lovers.💯

featured_reviews.review_text: Buskin Robbins have same nice taste all over Frenchieses for desserts. It's a small shop surrounded with 2-3 small shops so be careful while entering.

featured_reviews.name: Kausar Millwala
featured_reviews.review_text: It looks too amazing compared to its worth and taste. I was tempted solely by the look. But to be fair the taste was quite mediocre. The flavor of bubble gum wasn't there at all. The name's pretty deceptive.  It was a decent cake but nothing extra ordinary

featured_reviews.name: S A M.
featured_reviews.review_text: Baskin Robbins ice cream all time costly.... Not always affordable ..

featured_reviews.name: Juzer Sakerwala
featured_reviews.review_text: A wide range of flavors served in cups and waffle. Also has shakes. They will also sell large portions in take away containers. However  the choice in factory's party pack is very little.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Dhadha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located right next to Gupta Kulfi in Byculla, this is a decently large place as compared to most Baskin Robbins outlets. Friendly staff

We had the Brownie a La Mode sundae.

With Chocolate Ice cream, brownie and hot chocolate sauce and sprinkles it was a decent desert but nothing exceptional.

Pricewise quite expensive for the kind of sundae it was.

featured_reviews.name: Shadab
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Bad poor unprofessional service at Mazgaon Baskin Robbins ...
Keeping the bad service aside  Raspberry sorbet is a must try ... 1 medium scoop is for Rs 150   ...
Its yummy i just loved it...
My current favourite and flavour of the month

featured_reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, I found the kulfi quite underwhelming. Having tasted some truly exceptional kulfis in Mumbai, this one just didn’t measure up. It seems like some places get overhyped—perhaps by those who haven’t experienced authentic, rich kulfi before. Decent, but certainly not the best.

featured_reviews.name: Nikunj Chheda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Old stock items of 29t June  they gave  to customers on 9th August

The sales person asked to buy old stock while buying we missed checking dates

We wanted regular kulfi’s but they tried to sell premium by saying it’s better & unfortunately it was old stock which they got us to buy …

All Powderish kulfi & really  spoiled the mood of all  …

Bad experience after buying in good quantity, it is suprising someone does this, risking their reputation

We bought is for Rakshabandhan on 9th August
